findings_qualitative.value: CO(6-5) and continuum form a clumpy circum-nuclear ring (100–350 pc) with no detected nucleus

evidence.quote: both showing a ring configuration without a detectable nucleus

claims.hypothesis: Is there a Compton-thick AGN in NGC 1614?
claims.experiment: Nuclear non-detection limits in CO(6-5) and 435 um continuum converted to N_H
claims.finding: Compton-thick AGN ruled out with relatively high confidence

evidence.quote: rule out, with relatively high confidence, a Compton-thick AGN in NGC 1614

claims.hypothesis: Does the Kennicutt-Schmidt law hold at ~100 pc in NGC 1614?
claims.experiment: Compare Sigma_gas from CO(6-5) with Sigma_SFR from radio
claims.result: Weak correlation with thermal and total radio; nucleus SFR/gas ratio about an order of magnitude above nominal
claims.finding: Breakdown of the law at ~100 pc, possibly due to starburst feedback/outward propagation

evidence.quote: indicating a breakdown of the Kennicutt-Schmidt law on the linear scale of $\sim$100 pc

claims.hypothesis: Why does the nonthermal radio correlate more strongly with gas?
claims.experiment: Spearman correlations; consideration of B–n and cosmic-ray heating, PDR/CDR fits
claims.result: rho=0.81 for nonthermal; PDR with mechanical heating fits best
claims.finding: Likely magnetic field–density correlation rather than CR heating

evidence.quote: possibly due to an in situ correlation between the magnetic field strength and the gas density

why_this_data.value: Targets chosen as nearby with bright CO(6-5) in Herschel, giving ~100 pc resolution; Band 9 minimal absorption near transit

evidence.quote: because of their close proximity ($\rm D < 85\; Mpc$) and bright CO (6-5) line fluxes

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CR-dominated region models fit the data poorly compared with PDR models with mechanical heating

evidence.quote: PDR models with strong mechanical heating (by turbulence) provide the best fit while CDR models fit the data rather poorly

limitations_admitted.value: Interferometer misses extended emission; dust and gas masses are lower limits

evidence.quote: therefore the dust and gas mass derived from these observations are lower limits
